title: Ender Eye Remastered
description: This Datapack and Resource Pack makes getting to the End much harder and requires you to actually explore the world
body:
A Minecraft datapack that makes Ender Eyes much harder to craft: players must combine Blaze Powder, Ender Pearls, and the special Ender Research Book to create them. 


# How does it work
First you have to craft the ender research book. Then you can use it and 1 blaze powder and 1 ender pearl to to create an eye of ender. After that you can duplicate the eyes of ender with 1 blaze powder and 1 ender pearl
